goal: Find the center of the most distinct measurement-target region in the input camera image, move to the stage position corresponding to that center, and measure a spectrum once.

sample_context.visual_features: Small, dark, irregular-shaped particle on a light background.

execution_summary.trajectory: Used analyze_microscope_image to locate the target -> moved stage via move_to_pixel -> searched KB for safe biological parameters -> acquired spectrum using accumulate mode.
execution_summary.outcome: Successfully identified target particle in image, moved to coordinates (37.98, 25.353), and acquired a spectrum.

lesson: For unknown small particles that appear biological or organic, starting with conservative parameters (20% power) from the Biological Sample Raman Measurement Guide is a safe approach.

system_metrics.metrics: Max intensity 9482 ADU, SNR appears acceptable based on raw signal level.
